company_info.industry_info: Banking and Financial Services. RBC is one of the largest banks in Canada and the world by market capitalization. The company operates in diverse areas including personal banking, commercial banking, capital markets, wealth management, and insurance.
company_info.recent_news: July 30, 2026: RBC extends Vector Institute sponsorship through 2032 to advance responsible AI innovation and talent development. July 17, 2026: RBC Named North America's Best Bank, Canada's Best Bank and Canada's Best Investment Bank in Euromoney's 2026 Awards for Excellence. May 28, 2026: RBC reported Q2 2026 results with net income of $5.5 billion, up 25% from prior year. RBC has recently created a dedicated AI Group reporting to the CEO to drive AI ambitions and develop market-ready AI tools and solutions, including partnerships with Cohere and participation in MIT's FinTechAI initiative.
company_info.company_culture: RBC fosters a supportive and collaborative culture with strong emphasis on mentorship and employee development. According to Glassdoor reviews (11,061 reviews), employees highlight a friendly atmosphere, supportive colleagues, and friendly work environment. The company emphasizes diversity and inclusion, stating commitment to being an equal opportunity employer. RBC promotes continuous learning and professional development through coaching and growth opportunities.
company_info.any_related_information: RBC's AI Group was created to scale early-stage AI projects into client-facing solutions and advance research in generative and agentic AI. The company has developed ATOM (Asynchronous Temporal Model), a proprietary AI foundation model trained on billions of client financial transactions. RBC Assist and Aiden are proprietary AI assistant tools already in use by thousands of employees. The company is actively hiring for AI research and development roles at all levels, including software engineers. RBC targets delivering $700M in AI benefits by 2027. The company has strong partnerships with academic institutions including Vector Institute, Mila (Quebec AI Institute), Amii (Alberta Machine Intelligence Institute), and MIT CSAIL.
